notes.title: Arauco Saga Version 2.1 Update
notes.notes:
Arauco Saga Version 2.1 Update

- All Npc sprites have been changed, now they are bigger and more detailed. 
- Removed the bow and arrow weapon as it caused an imbalance in the gameplay in general. 
- Changed the animation of the trunk weapon 
- Slightly modified the market of all the villages. 
- the sprites of the wizard soldier were completely drawn.
- small bugs were fixed

notes.title: UPDATE VERSION 2.0
notes.notes:
UPDATE VERSION 2.0

1- Corrected all the language in English
2- Now you can buy the keys to the dungeons
3- Fixed trentren snake bugs
4- Fixed bug chonchon boss clones
5- Fixed the problem with the Minche key
6 - Fixed the problem with the keys when collecting more than one
7- Corrected the prices of the items in the markets
8- Corrected the final texts of the cinematics
9 - Fixed game intro loop problem
10 - General code update

notes.title: - Arauco Saga build V1.2
notes.notes:
Update V1.2


The game engine changed, which makes it impossible to have the version for mac and linux, which have been eliminated since they did not have users and also it can be played perfectly with wine for linux users.

Fixed various bugs

  - when the witcher was eliminated, he did not deliver the gem
- head mummy chichorro did not deliver gem
- various small bugs and redrawn sprites

With the new engine we can make more updates and fix bugs more quickly.
